question: What tāla measure is prescribed for making the image of Vighneśa?
premises: Vighneśa is the object to be made.
The highest five-tāla measure is specified.
A wise person is instructed to make it.
inference: The wise one should make Vighneśa according to the highest five-tāla measure.
plain_english: The wise one should indeed make Vighneśa according to the highest five-tāla measure.
